subject: [PATCH v3 12/18] selftests/mm: cover a shared-source collapse write race

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test case to the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c file, which checks for a shared-source collapse write race in the Linux kernel. The test case simulates a situation where a parent process writes to a shared range while its child process collapses it. The test ensures that the collapsing child sees the pre-fork content and the writing parent only sees its own writes. This patch helps to pin down isolation provided by khugepaged collapse, making the kernel more robust.
